title: polypodium molle
intro: Polypodium molle, commonly known as Polypody fern, is a species of fern in the family Polypodiaceae. It is traditionally used in folk medicine due to its potential health benefits, which include the ability to lower cholesterol levels, improve digestion, and reduce inflammation. The therapeutic actions of Polypodium molle include its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in wound healing and the treatment of various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
